summary: The root نَصَتَ (naṣata) means to be silent, often with the intention of listening. It can also mean to listen attentively.
lane: 1 نَصَتَ ذ , aor. نَصِبَ , (L, K,) inf. n. نَصْتٌ ; (L;) and , inf. n. إِنْصَاتٌ , (S, L, K) which latter is the more approved; (L;) and ; (L, K;) He was silent: (L, K:) or he was silent and listened: (S:) or he was silent to listen: (L:) or he was silent as one listening: (Er-Rághib:) or he listened: (Msb:) or انتصب signifies he stood, or paused, listening. (Msb.) -b2- , and انصت لَهُ , (S, K,) and إِلَيْهِ , (Z,) and نَصَتَ لَهُ , (L,) He was silent, and listened to his speech. (S, K, &c.)

headwords.def: aor. نَصِبَ, (L, K,) inf. n. نَصْتٌ; (L;) and, inf. n. إِنْصَاتٌ, (S, L, K) which latter is the more approved; (L;) and; (L, K;) He was silent: (L, K:) or he was silent and listened: (S:) or he was silent to listen: (L:) or he was silent as one listening: (Er-Rághib:) or he listened: (Msb:) or انتصب signifies he stood, or paused, listening. (Msb.), and انصت لَهُ, (S, K,) and إِلَيْهِ, (Z,) and نَصَتَ لَهُ, (L,) He was silent, and listened to his speech. (S, K, &c.)

He made him silent; silenced him. (Sh, K.) انصتهُ عَنِّى He made him to be silent, [ and to abstain ] from [ speaking of, or to, ] me. (As.) See 1. انصت لِلَّهْوِ He inclined to play, or sport. (IAar, K.)
He asked him, or desired him, to be silent: (K:) or, to be silent and to listen to him. (TA.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
mentions_note: Forms Lane discusses inside another entry rather than defining as a headword. Values index into headwords[].
